short: The steppe leader who united the Mongol tribes and founded the largest land empire in history.
full:
Born Temüjin, probably around 1162, he spent his early life in poverty and captivity after his father's murder. By 1206 he had defeated or absorbed every rival tribe on the Mongolian plateau and was proclaimed Genghis Khan — universal ruler.

He reorganised Mongol society away from tribal loyalty into a decimal military structure that promoted on merit, established a written script and a legal code, and guaranteed protection to merchants and envoys. His campaigns against the Jin dynasty and the Khwarazmian Empire were catastrophically destructive; some cities never recovered. He died in 1227, and his burial place is still unknown.
